achievement.1.description: [EN] You have an eye for suspicious places and love to read other people's diaries, especially those with vampire stories in it. You're also a dedicated token collector and explorer. Respect!
achievement.1.name: Castlemania
achievement.10.description: [EN] You follow the path of dreams and that of responsibility without self-centered power. Free from greed and selfishness, you help others without expecting a reward.
achievement.10.name: Chevalier des Cauchemars
achievement.100.description: [EN] Few things equal the wild fury of a trapped and riven creature. You were a worthy opponent.
achievement.100.name: Tueur d'Irahsae
achievement.101.description: [EN] Blind hatred took physical form, violently rebelling against the injustice it was born into. You were not able to bring justice - but at least temporary peace.
achievement.101.name: Tueur de Phrodomo
achievement.102.description: [EN] The forbidden knowledge of aeons was never meant to invade this world. You silenced its voice before it could be made heard.
achievement.102.name: Tueur de Teneshpar
achievement.103.description: [EN] You helped bringing Devovorga's dangerous tentacles and her humongous cocoon down - not stopping her transformation, but ultimately completing a crucial step to her death.
achievement.103.name: Cocon de malheur
achievement.104.description: [EN] One special hero among many. This year - it was you. Devovorga withdrew in a darker realm because she could not withstand your power - and that of your comrades. Time will tell if the choice you made was good - but for now, it saved your world.
achievement.104.name: Devovorga's Nemesis
achievement.105.description: [EN] Tired... so tired... curling up in a warm and cosy bed seems like the perfect thing to do right now. Sweet dreams!
achievement.105.name: Monsieur le marchand de sable
achievement.106.description: [EN] Sleeping - you do it with style. You're chilling in your hammock, listening to the sound of the birds and crickets as you slowly drift away into the realm of dreams.
achievement.106.name: Berce-moi pour dormir
achievement.107.description: [EN] You don't need much to sleep comfortably. A pile of straw and a roof over your head - with the latter being completely optional - is quite enough to relax. You don't even mind the rats nibbling on your toes.
achievement.107.name: Invité modeste
achievement.108.description: [EN] Well - the contents of that present weren't quite what you expected. With friends like these, who needs enemies?
achievement.108.name: La blague est sur toi
achievement.109.description: [EN] So much for your feathered little friend! Maybe standing in front of the birdcage, squeezing its neck and shouting 'Sing! Sing! Sing!' was a little too much for it?!
achievement.109.name: Oups
achievement.11.description: [EN] You've joined the undead bone brothers - making death your enemy and your weapon as well. Devouring what's weak and leaving space for what's strong is your primary goal.
achievement.11.name: Frère d'Os
achievement.110.description: [EN] You live the life of hunters and gatherers. Well, especially that of a gatherer, and especially of one who gathers lots of blueberries. Have you checked the colour of your tongue lately?
achievement.110.name: Bluebarian
achievement.111.description: [EN] Thick, red - shaken, not stirred - and with a straw in it: that's the way you prefer your demon blood. Served with an onion ring, the subtle metallic aftertaste is almost not noticeable. Beneficial effects on health or mana are welcome.
achievement.111.name: Barman démoniaque
achievement.112.description: [EN] You love the winter. Fully equipped with scarf and gloves, you like to have fun outside while building lots of snowmen with your friends. Snowball fight, anyone?
achievement.112.name: Le bonhomme de neige
achievement.113.name: Numéro de la Bête
achievement.114.description: [EN] You and your stuffed furry friends are inseparable, and you're not ashamed to take them to bed with you - who knows when you will wake up in the middle of the night in dire need of a cuddle?
achievement.114.name: J'ai besoin d'un câlin
achievement.115.description: [EN] Okay, let's face it - as long as you believe it could potentially lead you to the biggest treasure ever, you won't let go of that map, however fishy it might look. There must be a secret behind all of this!
achievement.115.name: Chance mince
achievement.116.description: [EN] Either you are not a fast learner or you find some pleasure in setting yourself on fire. Or you're just looking for a fancy title. In any case, you should know that passing gas during your little donkey experiments is not recommended.
achievement.116.name: Fusée en poche
achievement.117.description: [EN] But close your eyes and don't tell anyone what you wished for, or it won't come true!
achievement.117.name: Faire un vœu
achievement.118.description: [EN] Christmas is your favourite time of the year, and boy, do you love presents. Buy some nice things for your friends, hide them away until - well, until you decide to actually unwrap them rather yourself.
achievement.118.name: Le petit assistant du Père Noël
achievement.119.description: La colère du Noxious Spawn - vous avez accidentellement réussi à l'encourir. Vos jours sont comptés et votre mort inévitable. Un jour. Quelque part.
achievement.119.name: Cursed!
achievement.12.description: [EN] You travelled the world for an almost meaningless prayer - but at least you don't have to do that again and can get a new blessed stake in the blink of an eye.
achievement.12.name: Béni!
achievement.120.description: [EN] Yay! Finders keepers, losers weepers! Who cares where all that stuff came from and if you had to crawl through garbage piles to get it? It's FREE!
achievement.120.name: Articles gratuits !
achievement.121.description: [EN] Up and down and up and down... and then the big looping! Wait - they don't build loopings in Kazordoon. But ore wagon rides are still fun!
achievement.121.name: Rollercoaster
achievement.122.description: [EN] You, Sir or Lady, are a true alchemist. Conducting transmutating experiments to find every possible combination has been your secret passion since years and the results of your research are incredible. Science has just taken a leap thanks to you!
achievement.122.name: Transmutator
achievement.123.description: [EN] RAWR! Strength running through your body, your heart racing faster and adrenaline fueling your every weapon swing. All in a little bottle. No refund for destroyed furniture. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
achievement.123.name: Berserker
achievement.124.description: [EN] You feel you could solve the hardest riddles within a minute or so. Plus, there's a nice boost on your spell damage. All in a little bottle. Aftereffects - feeling slightly stupid. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
achievement.124.name: Cerveau
achievement.125.description: [EN] Improved eyesight, arrows and bolts flying at the speed of light and pinning your enemies with extra damage. All in a little bottle. No consumption of carrots required. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
achievement.125.name: Sharpshooter
achievement.126.description: Urgh! Fermez les fenêtres ! Fermez le soleil qui dresse sa vilaine tête jaune, fermez les rires déchirants des enfants corpulents de votre voisin. Ahhh. Embrassez la douce obscurité et le silence.
achievement.126.name: Ne pas déranger
achievement.127.description: [EN] Rise and shine! It's a beautiful new day - open your windows, feel the warm sunlight, watch the birds singing on your windowsill and care for your plants. What reason is there not to be happy?
achievement.127.name: Laissez entrer le soleil
achievement.128.description: [EN] Argh! Not now! How is it that those multifunctional tools never fail when you're using them for something completely trivial like squeezing juice, but mess up when you desperately need to climb up a rope spot with a fire-breathing dragon chasing you?
achievement.128.name: Mauvais timing
achievement.129.description: [EN] You laugh at unprepared adventurers stuck in high grass or rush wood. Or maybe you actually do help them out. They call you... 'Machete'.
achievement.129.name: Rien ne peut m'arrêter
achievement.13.description: [EN] You're a talented merchant who's able to handle wares with care, finds good offers and digs up rares every now and then. Never late to complete an order, you're a reliable trader - at least in Rashid's eyes.
achievement.13.name: Commerçant reconnu
achievement.130.description: [EN] Scythe swung over your shoulder, sun burning down on your back - you are a farmer at heart and love working in the fields. Or then again maybe you just create fancy crop circles to scare your fellow men.
achievement.130.name: Heureux fermier
achievement.131.description: [EN] Liberty Bay is the perfect hangout for you and harvesting sugar cane quite a relaxing leisure activity. Would you like some tea with your sugar, hon?
achievement.131.name: Édulcorant naturel
achievement.132.description: [EN] Yo-ho-ho and a bottle of rum - homebrewed, of course, made from handpicked and personally harvested sugar cane plants. Now, let it age in an oak barrel and enjoy it in about 10 years. Or for the impatient ones: Let's have a paaaarty right now!
achievement.132.name: Homebrewed
achievement.133.description: [EN] Hidden treasures below the sand dunes of the desert - you have a nose for finding them and you know where to dig. They might not make you filthy rich, but they're shiny and pretty anyhow.
achievement.133.name: Chercheur d'or
achievement.134.description: [EN] You and your shovel - a match made in heaven. Or hell, for that matter. Somewhere down below in any case. You're magically attracted by stone piles and love to open them up and see where those holes lead you. Good biceps as well.
achievement.134.name: L'entrepreneur
achievement.135.description: [EN] You can easily be found by anyone if they just follow the cookie crumb trail. And for you, true love means to give away your last cookie.
achievement.135.name: Monstre aux biscuits
achievement.136.description: Et quiconque prétend le contraire est un menteur.
achievement.136.name: Le gâteau est la vérité
achievement.137.description: [EN] The famous 'Ode to a Molten Chocolate Cake' was probably written by you. Spending a rainy afternoon in front of the chimney, wrapped in a blanket while indulging in cocoa delights sounds just like something you'd do. Enjoy!
achievement.137.name: Gourmand
achievement.138.description: [EN] You like your cake soft, with fruity bits and a nice sugar icing. And you prefer to make them by yourself. Have you ever considered opening a bakery? You must be really good by now!
achievement.138.name: Avec une cerise sur le dessus
achievement.139.description: [EN] Muahahaha it's a... mutated pumpkin! After helping to take it down - you DID help, didn't you? - you claimed your reward and got a more or less weird present. Happy Halloween!
achievement.139.name: Mutated Presents
achievement.14.description: [EN] You found and took a sip from the Fountain of Life. Thought it didn't grant you eternal life, you feel changed and somehow at peace.
achievement.14.name: Fontaine de vie
achievement.140.description: [EN] One of the Lightbearers. One of those who helped to keep the basins burning and worked together against the darkness. The demonic whispers behind the thin veil between the worlds - they were silenced again thanks to your help.
achievement.140.name: Gardien de la Flamme
achievement.141.description: [EN] You're one of the most dedicated Lightbearers - without you, the demons would have torn the veil between the worlds for sure. You've lit each and every basin, travelling high and low, pushing back the otherworldly forces. Let there be light!
achievement.141.name: Véritable porteur de Lumière
achievement.142.description: [EN] You have defeated the Snake God's incarnations and, with a final powerful swing of the snake sceptre, cut off his life force supply. The story of power, deceit and corruption has come to an end - or... not?
achievement.142.name: Godslayer
achievement.143.description: [EN] Uhm... who's that person who you just woke up beside? Broken cocktail glasses on the floor, flowers all over the room, and why the heck are you wearing a ring? Yesterday must have been a long, weird day...
achievement.143.name: Le lendemain
achievement.144.description: [EN] Longterm relationships are just not for you. And each time you think you're in love, you're proven wrong shortly afterwards. Or maybe you just end up with the wrong lover each time - exploited and betrayed. Staying single might just be better.
achievement.144.name: Phobique de l'engagement
achievement.145.description: Confiance? Amour? Fidélité? Pah ! Des sentiments désuets. Tant que vous vous amusez, cela ne vous dérange pas de marcher sur beaucoup de cœurs. De préférence en portant des bottes de combat.
achievement.145.name: Briseur de cœur
achievement.146.description: [EN] Stealth kills and backstabbing are you specialty. Your numerous victims are usually unaware of their imminent death, which you bring to them silently and swiftly. Everything is permitted.
achievement.146.name: Mort rapide
achievement.147.description: [EN] What is best in life? To crush your enemies. To see them driven before you. And to maybe have a nice cup of tea afterwards.
achievement.147.name: Politesse brutale
achievement.148.description: [EN] You're a beggar, homeless, wearing filthy and ragged clothes. But that doesn't mean you have to beg anyone for stuff - and you still kept your pride. Fine feathers do not necessarily make fine birds - what's under them is more important.
achievement.148.name: La vie dans la rue
achievement.149.description: [EN] Wearing the insignia and dark robes of the Brotherhood of Bones you roam the lands spreading fear and pain, creating new soldiers for the necromantic army which is about to rise soon. Hail the Brotherhood.
achievement.149.name: Crâne et os
achievement.15.description: [EN] You travelled the surreal realm of the elemental spheres, summoned and slayed the Lord of the Elements, all in order to retrieve neutral matter. And as brave as you were, you couldn't have done it without your team!
achievement.15.name: Seigneur des éléments
achievement.150.description: [EN] You do not fear nightmares, you travel in them - facing countless horrors and fighting the fate they're about to bring. Few believe the dark prophecies you bring back from those dreams, but those who do fight alongside you as Nightmare Knights.
achievement.150.name: Marcheur de cauchemar
achievement.151.description: [EN] Every city should be proud to call someone like you its inhabitant. You're keeping the streets clean and help settling the usual disputes in front of the depot. Also, you probably own a cat and like hiking.
achievement.151.name: Citoyen exemplaire
achievement.152.description: [EN] You don't carry that stake just for decoration - you're prepared to use it. Usually you're seen hightailing through the deepest dungeons leaving a trail of slain demons. Whoever dares stand in your way should prepare to die.
achievement.152.name: Demonbane
achievement.153.description: [EN] One with nature, one with wildlife. Raw and animalistic power, sharpened senses, howling on the highest cliffs and roaring in the thickest forests - that's you.
achievement.153.name: Des loups et des ours
achievement.154.description: [EN] At daytime you can be found camouflaged in the woods laying traps or chasing big game, at night you're sitting by the campfire and sharing your hunting stories. You eat what you hunted and wear what you skinned. Life could go on like that forever.
achievement.154.name: Chasser avec style
achievement.155.description: [EN] And remember: Never try to teach a pig to sing. It wastes your time and annoys the pig.
achievement.155.name: Fou de coeur
achievement.156.description: [EN] With edged blade and fully equipped in a sturdy full plate armor, you charge at your enemies with both strength and valour. There's always a maiden to save and a dragon to slay for you.
achievement.156.name: En armure brillante
achievement.157.description: [EN] You begin your day by bathing in your pot of gold and you don't mind showing off your wealth while strolling the streets in your best clothes - after all it's your hard-earned money! You prefer to be addressed with 'Your Highness'.
achievement.157.name: Aristocrate
achievement.158.description: [EN] Snow heaps and hailstorms can't keep you from where you want to go. You're perfectly equipped for any expedition into the perpetual ice and know how to keep your feet warm. If you're a woman, that's quite an accomplishment, too.
achievement.158.name: Dans la tempête de neige
achievement.159.description: [EN] You feel at home under the hot desert sun with sand between your toes, and your favourite means of travel is a flying carpet. Also, you can probably do that head isolation dance move.
achievement.159.name: Mille et un
achievement.16.description: [EN] You re-enacted the Taming of the Shrew on a beach setting and proved that you can handle capricious girls quite well. With or without fish tails.
achievement.16.name: Dompteur de plage
achievement.160.description: [EN] Ye be a gentleman o' fortune, fightin' and carousin' on the high seas, out fer booty and lassies! Ye no be answerin' to no man or blasted monarchy and yer life ain't fer the lily-livered. Aye, matey!
achievement.160.name: Swashbuckler
achievement.161.description: [EN] Shaking your rattle and dancing around the fire to jungle drums sounds like something you like doing. Besides, dreadlocks are a convenient way to wear your hair - no combing required!
achievement.161.name: Voie du chaman
achievement.162.description: [EN] You could be the author of the magnum opus 'How to Summon the Ultimate Beast from the Infernal Depths, Volume I'. Or, if your mind and heart are pure, you rather summon beings to help others. Or maybe just a little cat to have someone to cuddle.
achievement.162.name: Ritualist
achievement.163.description: [EN] You're not afraid to show your colours in the heat of battle. Enemies fear your lethal lance and impenetrable armor. The list of the wars you've won is impressive. Hail and kill!
achievement.163.name: Maître de guerre
achievement.164.description: [EN] Valour is for weaklings - it doesn't matter how you win the battle, as long as you're victorious. Thick armor would just hinder your movements, thus you keep it light and rely on speed and skill instead of hiding in an uncomfortable shell.
achievement.164.name: Wild Warrior
achievement.165.description: [EN] You're a humble warrior who doesn't need wealth or specialised equipment for travelling and fighting. You feel at home in the northern lands of Zao and did your part in fighting its corruption.
achievement.165.name: Peazzekeeper
achievement.166.description: [EN] Your deeds for Yalahar are usually characterised by deep insight and thoughtful actions. Thanks to you, Yalahar might have a chance to grow peacefully and with happy people living in it.
achievement.166.name: Yalahari de la sagesse
achievement.167.description: [EN] You defend Yalahar with brute force and are ready to lead it into a glorious battle, if necessary. Thanks to you, Yalahar will be powerful enough to stand up against any enemy.
achievement.167.name: Yalahari du pouvoir
achievement.168.description: [EN] Life can be so easy with the right cake at the right time - and you mastered baking many different ones, so you should be prepared for almost everything life decides to throw at you.
achievement.168.name: Morceau de gâteau
achievement.169.description: [EN] You're considered a first-rate graduate of the Magic Academy in Edron due to your pioneering discoveries and successful studies in the field of experimental magic and spell development. Ever considered teaching the Armageddon spell?
achievement.169.name: Alumni
achievement.17.description: [EN] When you do something, you do it right. You have an opinion and you stand by it - and no one will be able to convince you otherwise. On a sidenote, you're a bit on the brutal and war-oriented side, but that's not a bad thing, is it?
achievement.17.name: Disciple d'Azerus
achievement.170.description: [EN] You're proficient in the darker ways of magic and are usually found sitting inside a circle of candles and skulls muttering unspeakable words. Don't carry things too far or the demons might come get you.
achievement.170.name: Warlock
achievement.171.description: [EN] Indeed, you have a soft spot for rabbits. Maybe the rabbits you saved today will be the rabbits that will save you tomorrow. When you are really hungry.
achievement.171.name: Lapin a glissé
achievement.172.description: [EN] True scientists know their equipment. Testing new inventions is essential daily work for any hard working researcher. You showed no fear and took all the new equipment from Spectulus and Sinclair for a spin.
achievement.172.name: Cobaye
achievement.173.description: [EN] You went into the forest, met Rottin Wood and the Married Men and helped them out in their camp. Oh, and don't worry about those merchants. They won't dare mentioning the strangely large sums of gold they actually possessed which are missing now.
achievement.173.name: Joyeuses aventures
achievement.174.description: [EN] You passed their test and helped the Spirithunters testing equipment, researching the supernatural and catching ghosts - it's you they're gonna call.
achievement.174.name: Peur d'aucun fantôme !
achievement.175.description: [EN] Almost all the plants you tested for Chartan in Zao where inedible - you tasted them all, yet you're still standing! You should really get some fresh air now, though.
achievement.175.name: Extreme Degustation
achievement.176.description: [EN] You have bravely stepped onto the cake isle. Is there any more beautiful, tasty place to be in the whole world?
achievement.176.name: Conquérant du gâteau
achievement.177.description: [EN] You have cheered up a demon baby and returned it to its mother. A quick count of your fingers will reveal if you made it through unharmed.
achievement.177.name: Baby-sitter
achievement.178.description: [EN] You have cheered up a bunch of demon babies and returned them to their mother. Don't bother the burn marks, don't bother the strains of grey hair, don't bother the nights you wake up screaming. It was worth it ... probably ... somehow.
achievement.178.name: Nounou de l'enfer
achievement.179.description: [EN] You have sailed the nether seas with the Ghost Captain. Despite the perils, you and your fellow crewmen have braved the challenge.
achievement.179.name: Marin fantôme
achievement.18.description: [EN] You're a peacekeeper and listen to what the small people have to say. You've made up your mind and know who to help and for which reasons - and you do it consistently. Your war is fought with reason rather than weapons.
achievement.18.name: Disciple de Palimuth
achievement.180.description: [EN] You have sailed the nether seas with the Ghost Captain several times. The dangers of the nether have become familiar to you and unexperienced travelers turn to you for advice.
achievement.180.name: Voyageur spectral
achievement.181.description: [EN] Not fearing death or ghosts you have traveled with the ghost captain several times and are a seasoned traveler of the netherworld. The dead and the living whisper about your exploits with appreciation.
achievement.181.name: Pirate du Néant
achievement.182.description: [EN] You are a master of the nether sea and have traveled with the ghost captain so many times that you know his ship and the perils of the nether sea inside out. You laugh in the face of death and may return as a ghost pirate yourself in the afterlife!
achievement.182.name: Fléau de la mort
achievement.183.description: [EN] You have helped to keep the witches fire burning. Just watch your fingers, it's hot!
achievement.183.name: Allume-feu
achievement.184.description: [EN] You sacrificed ingredients to create the protective brew of the witches.
achievement.184.name: Sorcières Lil' Helper
achievement.185.description: [EN] You sacrificed a lot of ingredients to create the protective brew of the witches and played a significant part in the efforts to repel the dreaded banebringers. The drawback is that even the banebringers may take notice of you ...
achievement.185.name: Banebringers' Bane
achievement.186.description: [EN] To keep the witches' fire burning, you trashed a lot of the wood the bane bringers animated. Some might find your fascination for fire ... disturbing.
achievement.186.name: Fire Devil
achievement.187.description: Amour... feu ! Alors... brillant ! Il faut... buuuurrrn !
achievement.187.name: Pyromaniac
achievement.188.description: [EN] Your efforts in fighting back the banebringers has not gone unnoticed. You are a legend amongst the witches and your name is whispered with awe and admiration.
achievement.188.name: Sorcière honoraire
achievement.189.description: [EN] Oh, the joy of riding! You've just got your very first own mount. Conveniently enough you don't even need stables, but can summon it any time you like.
achievement.189.name: Cowboy né naturellement
achievement.19.description: [EN] You jump at every opportunity for a hunting challenge that's offered to you and carry out those tasks with deadly precision. You're a hunter at heart and a valuable member of the Paw & Fur Society.
achievement.19.name: Chasseur d'élite
achievement.190.description: [EN] Stones have always fascinated you. So has the chance of finding something really precious inside one of them. Statistically you should've discovered a few nice treasures by now. But then again, most statistics are overriden by Mother Disfortune.
achievement.190.name: Petrologist
achievement.191.description: [EN] You've discovered the Ancients' hidden powers - from now on, they will aid you in your adventures.
achievement.191.name: Pouvoirs cachés
achievement.192.description: [EN] You definitely know how to bring out the best in your furniture and decoration pieces. Beautiful.
achievement.192.name: J'aime ça Fantaisie
achievement.193.description: [EN] You always carry your obsidian knife with you and won't hesitate to use it. You've skinned countless little - and bigger - critters and yeah: they usually don't get any more beautiful on the inside. It's rather blood and gore and all that...
achievement.193.name: En profondeur
achievement.194.description: [EN] Staking vampires and demons has almost turned into your profession. You make sure to gather even the tiniest amount of evil dust particles. Beware of silicosis.
achievement.194.name: Cendres en poussière
achievement.196.description: [EN] Don't worry, no one will be able to take it from you. Probably.
achievement.196.name: Stocké en toute sécurité
achievement.197.description: Par les dieux ! Ca c'était quoi?
achievement.197.name: Il y a quelque chose là-dedans
achievement.198.description: [EN] Awww. Your very own little goldfish friend - he's cute, he's shiny and he can't complain should you forget to feed him. He'll definitely brighten up your day!
achievement.198.name: Animal silencieux
achievement.199.description: [EN] Hopping, hopping through the snow - that's the funnest way to go! Making footprints in a flurry - it's more fun the more you hurry! Licking icicles all day - Winter, never go away!
achievement.199.name: Lapin des neiges
achievement.2.description: Lalalala... vous connaissez désormais par cœur l'hymne de la secte chanté à Liberty Bay. Ce n’est pas si difficile, étant donné qu’il se compose principalement de deux notes et de paroles répétitives.
achievement.2.name: Choriste
achievement.20.description: [EN] You're familiar with hunting tasks and have carried out quite a few already. A bright career as hunter for the Paw & Fur society lies ahead!
achievement.20.name: Huntsman
achievement.200.description: [EN] Sinister curses, evil magic - you don't shy away from punishing others by questionable means. Someone just gave you a strange look - now where's that needle again?
achievement.200.name: Prêtre vaudou sombre
achievement.201.description: [EN] Home is where your current favourite hunting ground is, and though you might hold certain places more dear than others you never feel attached enough to really stay in one city for long. Pack all your stuff - it's time to move on again.
achievement.201.name: Âme nomade
achievement.202.description: [EN] You told Jack the truth by explaining you and Spectulus made a mistake when trying to convince him of being a completely different person.
achievement.202.name: La vérité soit dite
achievement.203.description: [EN] You did not tell Jack the truth about the mistake you and Spectulus made when trying to convince him about being a completely different person. He will live in doubt until the end of his existence.
achievement.203.name: Tu ne connais pas Jack
achievement.204.description: La Combined Magical Winterberry Society honore par la présente le dévouement désintéressé continu et les efforts extraordinaires lors du millésime annuel d’automne.
achievement.204.name: Cueilleur de baies
achievement.205.description: [EN] You and your friends showed the three wizards your loyalty three times - I am sure at least one of them is probably eternally thankful and exceedingly proud of you.
achievement.205.name: Vraies couleurs
achievement.206.description: [EN] You have mastered Kuriks challenge in all possible shapes.
achievement.206.name: Maître métamorphe
achievement.207.description: [EN] With the assistance of your friendly little helper, you gobbled more than 500 chunks of slime. Well done, Slimer.
achievement.207.name: Plus mince
achievement.208.description: [EN] You killed the raging mage in his tower south of Zao. Again. But this one just keeps coming back. The dimensional portal collapsed once more and you know he will eventually return but hey - a raging mage, it's like asking for it...
achievement.208.name: Mageslayer
achievement.209.description: [EN] You caught fifty rare shimmer swimmers. Getting rid of all those corpses by dumping them into the lake really was worth it, wasn't it? Wait, didn't something move in the water just now...?
achievement.209.name: Biodegradable
achievement.21.description: [EN] For you, a kiss is more than a simple touch of lips. You kiss maidens and deadbeats alike with unmatched affection and faced death and rebirth through the kiss of the banshee queen. Lucky are those who get to share such an intimate moment with you!
achievement.21.name: Embrasse passionnée
achievement.210.description: Vous n'y avez pas prêté attention - du moins pas trop longtemps... mais Groam l'a fait. Et tu l'as soulagé. Ne le dites pas à son ami Dronk.
achievement.210.name: Oeil des profondeurs
achievement.211.description: [EN] Many creatures of the deep have lost their lives by your hand. Three hundred have entered the depths of eternity. You should probably fear the revenge of the Eyes of the Deep.
achievement.211.name: Envahisseur des profondeurs
achievement.212.description: [EN] You extinguished 500 thornfires! You were there when the Firestarters took over Shadowthorn. You saved the day - and the home of some elves which will try to kill you nonetheless. Isn't it nice to see everything restored just as it was before..?
achievement.212.name: Firefighter
achievement.213.description: [EN] You managed to kill more than four hundred white deer - it looks like you are one of the main reasons they will soon be considered extinct, way to go!
achievement.213.name: Chasse au cerf
achievement.214.description: Vous êtes désormais l'archidémon royal des Askarak, le tueur de princes.
achievement.214.name: Askarak Nemesis
achievement.215.description: Vous êtes désormais l'ennemi juré du Shaburak, le tueur de princes.
achievement.215.name: Shaburak Nemesis
achievement.216.description: [EN] You broke the jar of Horestis - fifty times. Either you know no fear or simply ignore it. Whatever the case, you are "fearless" indeed.
achievement.216.name: Intrépide
achievement.217.description: [EN] Did someone call a doctor? You delivered 100 medicine bags to Ottokar of the Venore poor house in times of dire need, well done!
achievement.217.name: Médecin! Médecin!
achievement.218.description: [EN] You significantly helped the afflicted citizens of Venore in times of dire need. Somehow you still feel close to the victims of the fever outbreak. Your clothes make you one of them, one poor soul amongst the countless afflicted.
achievement.218.name: Docteur en bec
achievement.219.description: [EN] You vanquished the mad mage, you subdued the raging mage - no spellweaving self-exposer can stand in your way. Yet you are quite absorbed in magical studies yourself. This very fabric reflects this personal approval of the magic arts.
achievement.219.name: Magie mystique des tissus
achievement.22.description: [EN] You've proven yourself as a worthy member of the 'family' and successfully carried out numerous spy missions for your 'uncle' to support the Venorean traders and their goals.
achievement.22.name: Meilleur agent AVIN
achievement.221.description: [EN] You've shattered each of Bloodweb's eight frozen legs. As they say: break a leg, and then some more.
achievement.221.name: Arachnoise
achievement.222.description: [EN] You've descended into the swampy depths of Deathbine's lair and made quick work of it.
achievement.222.name: Comportement sans racines
achievement.223.description: [EN] You've slain Esmeralda, the most hideous and aggressive of the mutated rats. No one will know that you almost lost a finger in the process.
achievement.223.name: Mutation tordue
achievement.224.description: [EN] Ethershreck's cry of agony kept ringing in your ear for hours after he had dissolved into thin air. He probably moved to another plane of existence... for a while.
achievement.224.name: Belle agonie
achievement.225.description: [EN] A mighty blaze went out today. It's Flameborn's turn to wait for his rebirth in the eternal cycle of life and death.
achievement.225.name: Flammes brûlées
achievement.226.description: [EN] You ripped the ancient scarab Fleshcrawler apart and made sure he didn't get under your skin.
achievement.226.name: Mort rampante
achievement.227.description: [EN] You made a knot with Gorgo's living curls and took her scalp. You couldn't save her countless petrified victims, but at least you didn't become one.
achievement.227.name: La fiancée du serpent
achievement.228.description: [EN] You've found a well-hidden spider queen and caught her off guard in the middle of her meal.
achievement.228.name: Plus besoin de se cacher
achievement.229.description: [EN] It seems the gates to the underworld have to remain unprotected for a while. Kerberos, the mighty hellhound, lost his head. All three of them.
achievement.229.name: Les portes de l'enfer
achievement.23.description: [EN] Girl power! Whether you're female or not, you've proven absolute loyalty and the willingness to put your life at stake for the girls brigade of Carlin.
achievement.23.name: Meilleur agent CGB
achievement.230.description: [EN] As the killer of Leviathan, the giant sea serpent, his underwater kingdom is now under your reign.
achievement.230.name: Le dieu de la mer noyé
achievement.231.description: [EN] Ribstride is striding no more. He had quite a few ribs to spare though.
achievement.231.name: Côtes levées pour le dîner
achievement.232.description: [EN] You almost made friends with Shardhead... before he died. Poor guy only seems to attract violence with his frosty attitude.
achievement.232.name: Briser la glace
achievement.233.description: [EN] Stonecracker's head was much softer than the stones he threw at you.
achievement.233.name: Je viens de me faire craquer !
achievement.234.description: [EN] You've exinguished the Sulphur Scuttler's gas clouds and made the air in his cave a little better... at least for a while.
achievement.234.name: Quelque chose sent
achievement.235.description: Vous avez empalé le gros mammouth Bloodtusk avec ses propres défenses.
achievement.235.name: Brochette de Viande
achievement.236.description: [EN] The Many is no more, but how many more are there? One can never know.
achievement.236.name: Un de moins
achievement.237.description: Vous avez vaincu le Noxious Spawn et son cœur serpentin.
achievement.237.name: Chute sifflante
achievement.238.description: [EN] The Old Widow fell prey to your supreme hunting skills.
achievement.238.name: S'étouffer avec son venin
achievement.239.description: [EN] You've tainted the jungle floor with the Snapper's crimson blood.
achievement.239.name: Vivaneau rouge sang
achievement.24.description: [EN] Conspiracies and open secrets are your daily bread. You've shown loyalty to the Thaian crown through your courage when facing enemies and completing spy missions. You're an excellent field agent of the TBI.
achievement.24.name: Meilleur agent TBI
achievement.240.description: [EN] You've cut off a whole lot of tentacles today. Thul was driven back to where he belongs.
achievement.240.name: Retour dans les abysses
achievement.241.description: [EN] You've faced and defeated a lot of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
achievement.241.name: Pwned beaucoup de fourrure
achievement.242.description: [EN] You've stopped the bank robber and returned the bag full of gold. Good to know there are still lawful Tibians like you around.
achievement.242.name: Chercheur honnête
achievement.243.description: [EN] If it wasn't for you, several banks in Tibia would've gotten bankrupt by now. Keep on chasing bank robbers and no one will have to worry about the Tibian economy!
achievement.243.name: Chasseur d'or
achievement.244.description: [EN] You've discovered a trail of giant footprints and terrified elephants running everywhere. Could it be that the mysterious ape god is rambling in the jungle?
achievement.244.name: La piste du dieu singe
achievement.245.description: Ce n'était PAS une araignée géante. Il y a de la sorcellerie à l'œuvre ici.
achievement.245.name: Quelqu'un s'ennuie
achievement.246.description: Vous ne pouvez pas garder un secret, n'est-ce pas ? Là encore, vous ne faites que remplir votre devoir envers la reine de Carlin en tant que citoyen légitime. C'est une bonne chose, n'est-ce pas... ?
achievement.246.name: Lanceur d'alerte
achievement.247.description: [EN] Wyda seems to be really, really bored. You also found out that she doesn't really need all those blood herbs that adventurers brought her. Still, she was nice enough to take one from you and gave you something quite cool in exchange.
achievement.247.name: Trésors déchirés
achievement.248.description: Vous avez participé aux festivités du Jour du Roi et avez rendu hommage au roi Tibianus. Maintenant, c'est parti pour faire la fête !
achievement.248.name: Sujet fidèle
achievement.249.description: [EN] You managed to catch a fish in a surrounding that usually doesn't even carry water. Everything is subject to change, probably...
achievement.249.name: Pêcheur du désert
achievement.25.description: [EN] Pack your spy gear and get ready for some dangerous missions in service of a secret agency. You've shown you want to - but can you really do it? Time will tell.
achievement.25.name: Agent secret
achievement.251.description: [EN] You showed Noodles the way home. How long will it take this time until he's on the loose again? That dog must be really bored in the throne room by now.
achievement.251.name: Garde de chien
achievement.252.description: [EN] You witnessed the thawing of Svargrond and harvested rare seeds from some strange icy plants. They must be good for something.
achievement.252.name: Récolteuse de glace
achievement.253.description: [EN] You are a pretty smart thinker and managed to create everlasting flowers. They might become a big hit with all the people who aren't blessed with a green thumb or just forgetful.
achievement.253.name: Preservationist
achievement.254.description: [EN] You've discovered three nomad camps and stole their supplies. Well, you can probably use them better then they can.
achievement.254.name: Voleur de coffre
achievement.255.description: [EN] You've found a secret dungeon in the flooded plains and killed several of its inhabitants. And now you have wet feet.
achievement.255.name: Dans les égouts
achievement.256.description: [EN] You've survived the Hellgorge eruption and found a way through the flames and lava. You've even managed to kill a few fireborn on the way.
achievement.256.name: Le feu de la Terre
achievement.257.description: [EN] Your actions start to make a difference. You have blinded the antennae of the hive often enough to become an annoyance to it.
achievement.257.name: Perturbation mineure
achievement.258.description: [EN] In the war against the hive, your efforts in blinding it begin to pay off. Your actions have blinded the hive severely and the entity seems to become aware that something dangerous is happening.
achievement.258.name: Dazzler
achievement.259.description: [EN] You have put a lot of time and energy into keeping the hive unaware of what is happening on Quirefang. The hive learnt to fear your actions. It would surely crush you with all its might ... if it could only find you!
achievement.259.name: Blindeur de ruche
achievement.26.description: [EN] You're an aspiring mago-mechanic. Science and magic work well together in your eyes - and even though you probably delivered countless wrong charges while working for Telas, you might just have enough knowledge to build your own golem now.
achievement.26.name: Golem dans les engrenages
achievement.260.description: [EN] You have grown accustomed to frequenting the hive's stomach system. Your actions have caused the hive some first digestion problems.
achievement.260.name: Hickup
achievement.261.description: [EN] Never-tiring, you attack the inner organs of the mighty hive. Your attacks on the hive's digestion system begin to cause some trouble.
achievement.261.name: Brûlures d'estomac
achievement.262.description: [EN] You severely disrupted the digestion of the hive. The hive should for sure see a doctor. It seems you proved to be more than it can swallow.
achievement.262.name: Ulcère d'estomac
achievement.263.description: [EN] The hive has to be fought with might and main, hampering its soldiers is only the first step. You diligently stopped the pores of the hive to spread its warriors.
achievement.263.name: Planteur
achievement.264.description: [EN] You are getting more and more experienced in destroying the supply of the enemy's forces. Your actions caused the hive some severe skin problems.
achievement.264.name: Bouton
achievement.265.description: [EN] A war is won by those who have the best supply of troops. The hive's troops have been dealt a significant blow by your actions. You interrupted the hive's replenishment of troops lastingly and severely.
achievement.265.name: Suppressor
achievement.266.description: [EN] By killing creatures of the hive and gaining weapons for further missions, you started a quite effective way of war. You gathered a lot of dissolved chitin to resupply the war effort.
achievement.266.name: Cueilleur
achievement.267.description: [EN] The need for supplies often decides over loss or victory. Your tireless efforts to resupply the resources keeps the war against the hive going.
achievement.267.name: Fournisseur
achievement.268.description: [EN] You have become competent and efficient in gathering the substance that is needed to fight the hive. You almost smell like dissolved chitin and the Hive Born would tell their children scary stories about you if they could speak.
achievement.268.name: Chitin Bane
achievement.269.description: [EN] You have proven that you can beat the best of the hive. You have caused first promising breaches in the defence of the hive
achievement.269.name: Tueur de gardes
achievement.27.description: [EN] Poems, verses, songs and rhymes you've recited many times. You have passed the cryptic door, raconteur of ancient lore. Even elves you've left impressed, so it seems you're truly blessed.
achievement.27.name: Poète lauréat
achievement.270.description: [EN] The most powerful warriors of the hive were killed by you by the dozens. The hive is not safe anymore because of your actions.
achievement.270.name: Infiltrateur de ruche
achievement.271.description: [EN] Efficient and lethal, you have gained significant experience in fighting the elite forces of the hive. Almost single-handed, you have slain the best of the Hive Born and live to tell the tale.
achievement.271.name: Exterminator
achievement.272.description: [EN] Even in the deepest structures of the hive, you began to strike against the mighty foe. Your actions probably already gave the hive a headache.
achievement.272.name: Mal de tête
achievement.273.description: [EN] The destruction you have caused by now can be felt throughout the whole hive. The mayhem that follows your step caused significant confusion in the consciousness of the hive.
achievement.273.name: Confusion
achievement.274.description: [EN] You have destroyed a significant amount of the hive's vital nerve centers and caused massive destruction to the hive's awareness. You are probably causing the hive horrible nightmares.
achievement.274.name: Maniaque
achievement.276.name: Erreur de navigation
achievement.277.description: [EN] You've found the oriental traveller Yasir and were able to trade with him - even if you didn't really understand his language.
achievement.277.name: Si, Ariki!
achievement.278.description: Vous avez mis fin à la vie de plus de trois cents gardes des profondeurs. Vous n'êtes pas tout à fait le gardien des Deeplings, n'est-ce pas ?
achievement.278.name: Chute du gardien
achievement.279.description: [EN] You hushed the songs of war in the black depths by sliencing more than three hundred Deepling Spellsingers.
achievement.279.name: Chanson de la mort
achievement.28.description: [EN] You can handle any music instrument you're given - and actually manage to produce a pleasant sound with it. You're a welcome guest and entertainer in most taverns.
achievement.28.name: Ménestrel
achievement.280.description: [EN] By eliminating at least three hundred Deepling Warriors you delivered quite a blow to the amassing armies of the deep.
achievement.280.name: Habitants des profondeurs
achievement.281.description: [EN] You cut your first gem - and it bears your own name! Now that would be a nice gift! This does not make it a "true" Heart of the Sea, however...
achievement.281.name: Coupeur de pierres précieuses
achievement.282.description: [EN] You travelled the depths of this very world. You entered the blackness of the deep sea to conquer the realm of the Deeplings. May this suit remind you of the strange beauty below.
achievement.282.name: Spolium Profundis
achievement.283.description: [EN] Countless fights and never tiring effort in the war against the hive grant you the experience to finish your outfit with the last remaining part. Your chitin outfit is a testament of your skills and dedication for the cause.
achievement.283.name: Le fléau de la ruche
achievement.285.description: [EN] Your invaluable experience in fighting the hive allows you to add another piece of armor to your chitin outfit to prove your dedication for the cause.
achievement.285.name: Vétéran de la Guerre des Ruches
achievement.286.description: [EN] You have participated that much in the hive war, that you are able to create some makeshift armor from the remains of dead hive born that can be found in the major hive, to show of your skill.
achievement.286.name: Combattant de la ruche
achievement.287.description: Vous avez étouffé le hurlement éternel d'Hemming.
achievement.287.name: Silence hurlant
achievement.288.description: [EN] No more fear and bad dreams. You stabbed Tormentor to death with its scythe leg.
achievement.288.name: Le rêve est terminé
achievement.289.description: [EN] You wiped Fazzrah away - zzeemzz like now you're the captain.
achievement.289.name: Zzztill Zzztanding!
achievement.29.description: [EN] You know Banuta like the back of your hand and are good at destroying caskets and urns. The sight of giant footprints doesn't keep you from exploring unknown areas either.
achievement.29.name: Ami des singes
achievement.290.description: Cette fois, tu as éliminé le gros.
achievement.290.name: J'ai marché sur un gros orteil
achievement.291.description: Sans blague, tu as tué la chauve-souris.
achievement.291.name: Kapow!
achievement.292.description: [EN] You gave zzze draken a tazte of your finizzzing move.
achievement.292.name: Entrez Zze Draken !
achievement.293.description: [EN] Bretzecutioner's body just got slammed away. You are a true king of the ring!
achievement.293.name: Roi de l'Anneau
achievement.294.description: [EN] You overcame the undead Zanakeph and sent him back into the darkness that spawned him.
achievement.294.name: De retour d'entre les morts
achievement.295.description: [EN] You've faced and defeated each of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
achievement.295.name: Pwned toute la fourrure
achievement.297.description: [EN] You lend a helping hand in defeating invading Orcs by destroying their warcamp along with their leader. Bibby's personal bloodbath...
achievement.297.name: Le bain de sang de Bibby
achievement.298.description: [EN] You cleansed the land from an eight legged nuisance by defeating Mamma Longlegs three times. She won't be back soon... or will she?
achievement.298.name: Nestling
achievement.299.description: [EN] You did it! You convinced the reclusive gnomes to accept you as one of their Bigfoots. Now you are ready to help them. With big feet big missions seen to come.
achievement.299.name: Devenir un Bigfoot
achievement.3.description: Qui est le laitier ? Tu es!
achievement.3.name: Le laitier
achievement.30.description: [EN] Your map is your friend — always in your back pocket and covered with countless marks of interesting and useful locations. One could say that you might be lost without it — but luckily there's no way to take it from you.
achievement.30.name: Territorial
achievement.300.description: [EN] You think the gnomes start to like you. A little step for a Bigfoot but a big step for humanity.
achievement.300.name: Gnome petit assistant
achievement.301.description: [EN] The gnomes are warming up to you. One or two of them might actually bother to remember your name. You're allowed to access their gnomebase alpha. You are prepared to boldly put your big feet into areas few humans have walked before.
achievement.301.name: Ami Gnome
achievement.302.description: [EN] You have become a household name in gnomish society! Your name is mentioned by gnomes more than once. Of course usually by gnomish mothers whose children refuse to eat their mushroom soup, but you are certainly making some tremendous progress.
achievement.302.name: Gnome
achievement.303.description: [EN] You accomplished what few humans ever will: you truly impressed the gnomes. This might not change their outlook on humanity as a whole, but at least you can bathe in gnomish respect! And don't forget you're now allowed to enter the warzones!
achievement.303.name: Gnome honoraire
achievement.304.description: [EN] You brought two loving crystals together. Perhaps they might even name one of their children after you. Too bad you forgot to leave your calling card.
achievement.304.name: Cristaux amoureux
achievement.305.description: [EN] Ring-a-ding! You have visited the golem workshop and lent a hand in repairing them. To know those golems are safe is worth all the bruises, isn't it?
achievement.305.name: Remplacer le bricoleur
achievement.306.description: [EN] After hunting for the correct mushrooms and their spores you're starting to feel like a mushroom yourself. A few times more and you might start thinking like a mushroom, who knows?
achievement.306.name: Chasseur de spores
achievement.307.description: [EN] Burnt fingers and itching lungs are a small price for bringing those gnomes some lousy stone and getting almost killed! Your mother warned you to better become a farmer.
achievement.307.name: Broyer à nouveau
achievement.308.description: [EN] Seen it all. Done it all. Your unstoppable force swept through the dungeons and you vanquished their masters. Not to forget the precious loot you took! Now stop reading this and continue hunting! Time is money after all!
achievement.308.name: Nettoyeur de donjon
achievement.309.description: [EN] So you repaired the light of some crystals for those gnomes. What's next? Sitting a week in a mushroom bed as a temporary mushroom?
achievement.309.name: Gardien de cristal
achievement.31.description: Vous vous êtes révélé être un allié précieux pour les Marid, et Gabel vous a invité à échanger avec Haroun et Nah'Bob quand vous le souhaitez. Même si la guerre des Djinns n'est toujours pas terminée, les Marids ne peuvent pas échouer avec vous à leurs côtés.
achievement.31.name: Marid Ally
achievement.310.description: [EN] Admittedly you enjoyed the killing as usual. But the part with the sparks still gives you shivers ... or is it that there is some charge left on you?
achievement.310.name: Appelle-moi Sparky
achievement.311.description: [EN] One Bigfoot won over thousands of tiny feet. Perhaps the gnomes are wrong and size matters?
achievement.311.name: Un pied contre. Beaucoup
achievement.312.description: [EN] The gnomes decided their pigs need some exclusive diet and you had to do all the dirty work - but wasn't the piglet adorable?
achievement.312.name: Le cochon difficile
achievement.313.description: [EN] You killed the ambassador of the abyss that often that they might consider sending another one. Perhaps that will one day stop further intrusions.
achievement.313.name: Immunité diplomatique
achievement.314.description: [EN] Have you ever wondered how he reappears again and again? You only care for the loot, do you? Gotcha!
achievement.314.name: Chute des morts
achievement.315.description: À maintes reprises, Deathstrike est tombé sous vos prouesses. Il est peut-être temps pour les gens de VOUS appeler Deathstrike à partir de maintenant.
achievement.315.name: Mort en grève
achievement.316.description: [EN] The face of the enemy is unmasked. You have encountered one of 'those below' and survived. More than that, you managed to kill the beast and prove once and for all that the enemy can be beaten.
achievement.316.name: La mort d'en bas
achievement.317.description: [EN] The fallen gnome is dead and justice served. But what was it that the gnome whispered with his last breath? He's your father???
achievement.317.name: Le Fléau de Gnomebane
achievement.318.description: [EN] The mighty Deathstrike is dead! One legend is dead and you're on your way to become one yourself.
achievement.318.name: Frappe finale
achievement.319.description: [EN] Seeing a mucus plug makes your heart dance and you can't resist to see what it hides. Goo goo away!
achievement.319.name: Goo Goo Danseur
achievement.32.description: [EN] Even though the Efreet welcomed you only reluctantly and viewed you as "only a human" for quite some time, you managed to impress Malor and gained his respect and trade options with the green djinns.
achievement.32.name: Efreet Ally
achievement.320.description: [EN] Finally your dream to become a walking mushroom has come true ... No, wait a minute!
achievement.320.name: Funghitastic
achievement.321.description: [EN] If the gnomes had told you that crystal armor is see-through you had probably changed your underwear in time.
achievement.321.name: Crystal Clear
achievement.322.description: [EN] You have unleashed your inner gnome and slain some of the most fearsome threats that gnomekind has ever faced. Now you can come and go to the warzones as it pleases you. The enemies of gnomekind will never be safe again.
achievement.322.name: L'art gnome de la guerre
achievement.324.description: [EN] You conquered the demon challenge and prevailed... now show off your success in style!
achievement.324.name: Véritable dévouement
achievement.325.description: [EN] Helping a poor, stupid goblin to feed his starving children and wifes feels good ... if you'd only get rid of the strange feeling that you're missing something.
achievement.325.name: Gestionnaire de tâches
achievement.326.description: Aider le plan maladif d'Omrabas à ressusciter vous a obligé à vous frayer un chemin à travers les couloirs imbibés de sang de Drefia. Peut-être mieux qu'il ait échoué !
achievement.326.name: Gravedigger
achievement.327.description: [EN] You cleansed your soul in serving the Repenter enclave and purified thine self in completing all tasks in a single day of labour.
achievement.327.name: Repentir
achievement.328.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your blade into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.328.name: Épéiste ombral
achievement.33.description: [EN] Dreams - are your reality? Strange visions, ticking clocks, going to bed and waking up somewhere completely else - that was some trip, but you're almost sure you actually did enjoy it.
achievement.33.name: Rêveur lucide
achievement.331.description: [EN] You have helped the gnomes of the spike in securing the caves and explored enough of the lightles depths to earn you a complete cave explorers outfit. Well done!
achievement.331.name: Achèvement des grottes
achievement.332.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your slayer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.332.name: Umbral Bladelord
achievement.333.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your axe into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.333.name: Umbral Headsman
achievement.334.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your chopper into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.334.name: Bourreau ombral
achievement.335.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your mace into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.335.name: Bagarreur ombral
achievement.336.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your hammer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.336.name: Berserker ombral
achievement.337.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your bow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.337.name: Archer ombral
achievement.338.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your crossbow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.338.name: Tireur d'élite ombral
achievement.339.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your spellbook into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.339.name: Umbral Harbinger
achievement.34.description: [EN] You've been to places most people don't even know the names of. Collecting botanic, zoologic and ectoplasmic samples is your daily business and you're always prepared to discover new horizons.
achievement.34.name: Explorateur
achievement.340.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify all kinds of weapons into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world. Respect!
achievement.340.name: Maître de l'Umbra
achievement.341.description: [EN] You collected all of the mysterious bottle messages around the island of Roshamuul and located the remains of the first mate. Time will tell if his tale of mending an evil ring holds true.
achievement.341.name: Nevermending Story
achievement.342.description: [EN] What a scientific discovery - they really DO communicate! Using their own communication habits against them, you lured a large pack of silencers away from the walls of Roshamuul.
achievement.342.name: Attirer le silence
achievement.343.description: [EN] You did not show any signs of surrender to any sight of... you get the picture. Even a hundred of them did not pose a threat to you.
achievement.343.name: Ne vous rendez jamais
achievement.344.description: [EN] You have mended many a broken dream and so, the dream of Roshamuul is safely being told over and over again.
achievement.344.name: Rêve Wright
achievement.345.description: [EN] You have cleansed the lands of many retching horrors. You sure know how to end a bad dream: forcefully, that's how!
achievement.345.name: Mettre fin à l'horreur
achievement.346.description: [EN] You know your way, in dream and waking. And how to make tea that transcends the boundaries of conscience.
achievement.346.name: Sleepwalking
achievement.347.description: [EN] It doesn't matter what noise you would hear... dream, nightmare, illusion - there is nothing you can't vanquish. You are a true Dream Warden.
achievement.347.name: Gardien des rêves
achievement.348.description: [EN] Gaz'haragoth... a day to remember! Your world accomplished something really big - and you have been part of it!
achievement.348.name: Évasion de prison
achievement.349.description: [EN] After a battle like this you know who your friends are.
achievement.349.name: Noblesse anéantie
achievement.35.description: Même l’environnement sous-marin hostile ne vous empêche pas de faire votre devoir pour l’Explorer Society. Explorer le royaume de Quara est un jeu d'enfant pour vous.
achievement.35.name: Éclaireur marin
achievement.350.description: [EN] Through the spirit of science and exploration, you have discovered how to enter the secret hideout of the renowned Dr Merlay.
achievement.350.name: Élémentaire, mon cher
achievement.351.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Commoner.
achievement.351.name: Rathleton Commoner
achievement.352.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Inhabitant.
achievement.352.name: Habitant de Rathleton
achievement.353.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Citizen.
achievement.353.name: Citoyen de Rathleton
achievement.354.description: [EN] You accomplished 10 or more consecutive chains in a row! That's killing at least 39 creatures in the correct order - now that's combinatorics!
achievement.354.name: Maître des combos
achievement.355.description: [EN] Though you might have averted a dire threat for Rathleton, this relative peace may only hold for a while. At least you've scavenged an outfit from some of the poor fellows that have fallen prey to death priest Shagron.
achievement.355.name: Ingénieur Glooth
achievement.356.description: [EN] You discovered the Lion's Rock, passed the tests to enter the inner sanctum and finally revealed the secrets of the buried temple. You literally put your head in the lion's mouth and survived.
achievement.356.name: Explorateur de la fosse aux lions
achievement.357.description: [EN] Adventure is your middle name. You spent much time in dangerous lands and have seen things others only dream of. You know your way around in Tibia - you are a seasoned adventurer now. And your journey has only just begun!
achievement.357.name: Aventurier chevronné
achievement.358.description: [EN] You've got a mind ready to draw strange conclusions that defy the laws of logic and sidestep reality. Or maybe it's just a lucky guess - or adventurous recklessness?
achievement.358.name: Mind the Step!
achievement.359.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Squire.
achievement.359.name: Écuyer Rathleton
achievement.36.description: [EN] Wow - what was that? You don't know how you ended up here, but somehow you did. How to get from Beregar to Kazordoon in a jiffy - that's something those dwarves would love to know, but you're not quite sure how to reproduce it.
achievement.36.name: Pathfinder peu probable
achievement.360.description: [EN] He seriously stored away a wallnut? That was a nutty professor indeed.
achievement.360.name: La noix du professeur
achievement.361.description: [EN] You have defeated the wallbreaker and saved the glooth plant.
achievement.361.name: Plante contre Minos
achievement.362.description: [EN] You have defeated the tremor worm - and wonder what kind of fish you'd be able to catch with such a bait.
achievement.362.name: Grondement dans l'usine
achievement.363.description: [EN] You have defeated the glooth bomb and chopped down a lot of metal monsters on your way.
achievement.363.name: Couper le robot
achievement.364.description: Vous avez échappé au piège mortel de lave brûlante que le professeur Maxxen vous a tendu - le capitaine Caveworm est en effet fier !
achievement.364.name: Allez avec Da Lava Flow
achievement.365.description: [EN] You saw the Crystal Gardens with all their stunning beauty and survived the equally impressive monsters there. In the end you discovered a great evil and destroyed it with the help of a banshee who was not even aware of her support.
achievement.365.name: Lamentation de la Banshee
achievement.366.description: Vous êtes un homme du public. Ou de bonne publicité du moins. Grâce à vos efforts pour faire la publicité du tissu hermétique, Zeronex pourrait encore être racheté - et Rathleton pourrait encore voir son premier Gloud Ship fonctionnel.
achievement.366.name: Publicité
achievement.367.description: En restaurant l'Autel affamé, vous avez ramené le Serpent de mer aux plumes de feu dans son sommeil agité, à trente kilomètres sous la mer.
achievement.367.name: Charmeur de serpent
achievement.368.description: [EN] Your adventurous way through countless dragon lairs earned you a pretty treasure - and surely the enmity of many a dragon.
achievement.368.name: Trésor du dragon
achievement.37.description: [EN] Warm, furry and cuddly - though that same bear you just hugged would probably rip you into pieces if he had been conscious, he reminded you of that old teddy bear which always slept in your bed when you were still small.
achievement.37.name: Bearhugger
achievement.370.description: [EN] You found a lost sheep and thus a steady source of black wool. But careful: don't get entangled.
achievement.370.name: Petite pelote de laine
achievement.371.description: [EN] You made some efforts to bring a little more light into the world. And what a nice present you got in return!
achievement.371.name: Chaton Lumineux
achievement.372.description: [EN] By setting the right tone you convinced a crystal wolf to accompany you. Remember it is made of crystal, though, so be careful in a banshee's presence.
achievement.372.name: Le bon ton
achievement.373.description: [EN] Having a loyal friend alongside is comforting to every adventurer. If only this lad was not so stubborn...
achievement.373.name: Garçon fidèle
achievement.374.description: [EN] It's not really a dragon, but rather a kind of chimera. Nonetheless a decent mount to impress any passer-by.
achievement.374.name: Mimétisme du dragon
achievement.375.description: [EN] The Muggy Plains are a dangerous place, often raided by dragons. But that was your luck: thus you found this scaly little guy.
achievement.375.name: Écailles et queue
achievement.376.description: [EN] There are many delusions and phantasms in the desert. You saw a false oasis with fruit-bearing palm trees. Instead of water and refreshment, however, you found a dromedary in the end. What a useful Fata Morgana!
achievement.376.name: Fata Morgana
achievement.377.description: [EN] Finding all the pieces to this complicated vehicle was one kind of a challenge. However, what you built in the end is rather a fabled than a feeble construction.
achievement.377.name: Construction légendaire
achievement.378.description: [EN] Barking dogs never bite, as the saying goes. But this one clearly tried. In the end, however, you were able to walk the dog - ahem, gnarlhound.
achievement.378.name: Attention au chien !
achievement.379.description: [EN] This magnetic beast attracted you in a very literal way. Or was it attracted by your metal equipment? Anyway, you seem to be stuck together now.
achievement.379.name: Magnetised
achievement.38.description: [EN] You don't hunt them, you talk to them. You know that ghosts might keep secrets that have been long lost among the living, and you're skilled at talking them into revealing them to you.
achievement.38.name: Ghostwhisperer
achievement.380.description: [EN] Counting ten thousand grains of sand could not have been harder than gaining this impressive mount.
achievement.380.name: Sables dorés
achievement.381.description: [EN] Kingly deer mostly prefer elves as friends and familiars. This one, however, decided to favour you as a confidant and rider. Well done!
achievement.381.name: Ami des Elfes
achievement.382.description: [EN] Finding a four-leaved clover is always a sign of luck. And as luck would have it, you even baited a lovely dotted ladybug. Lucky you!
achievement.382.name: Beaux points
achievement.383.description: [EN] This fiery beast really tried to give you hell. But not even a magma crawler can resist a mug of spicy, hot glow wine. Skol!
achievement.383.name: Chemin vers l'enfer
achievement.384.description: [EN] Not really twenty thousand miles, but you had to dive a fair way beneath the sea to find your personal Manta Ray.
achievement.384.name: Sous la mer
achievement.385.description: [EN] By many it is considered a myth like the Yeti. But you came, saw and tamed it. Now you're the proud rider of a midnight panther, black as a starless night.
achievement.385.name: Starless Night
achievement.386.description: [EN] By mastering the secrets of Lion's Rock, you proved yourself worthy to face the mighty lions there. One of them even chose to accompany you.
achievement.386.name: Roi Lion
achievement.387.description: [EN] Ah, the old carrot-on-a-stick trick. Well done! You've made the racing bird accept you as a rider and provider. Just don't feed it your fingers.
achievement.387.name: Ordre hiérarchique
achievement.388.description: Whoa, semez longtemps ! Ce sanglier est comme une force de la nature, perçant les sous-bois de toutes les forêts du Tibien et tous les records de vitesse. Accrochez-vous!
achievement.388.name: Entêté
achievement.389.description: [EN] It might come as a shock to you, but this is the mount of your dreams. Not exactly the white steed of Prince Charming, but maybe the ladies will still scream and faint at the sight of you.
achievement.389.name: Cauchemar personnel
achievement.39.description: [EN] You have a soft spot for little, weak animals, and you do everything in your power to protect them - even if you probably eat dragons for breakfast.
achievement.39.name: Activiste des animaux
achievement.390.description: C'est imparable ! Des murs ? Des forteresses ? Des obstacles ? Des objections ? Pah ! Rien ne résistera au tamponneur. Flèches et lances rebondissent sur sa peau, les ennemis sont piétinés par dizaines. N'optez pas pour une approche subtile ou un rendez-vous sur cette chose.
achievement.390.name: À peau épaisse
achievement.391.description: [EN] Don't let its fluffy appearance deceive you. The panda is a creature of the wild. It will take you to the most distant regions of Tibia, always in hopes of a little bamboo to nibble on or to check on a possible mate.
achievement.391.name: Teddy à carreaux
achievement.392.description: [EN] Well, you can rest your nailcase now. This gravedigger's fingernails are nice and clean. Though after the next hellride, you might not want to let it hand any food to you.
achievement.392.name: Blacknailed
achievement.393.description: [EN] Drugging a snail can have some beneficial side effects. You're now the proud owner of a snarling, speed-crazy slug. Maybe it'll purr if you stroke it. Anyway, life should be one slick ride from now on.
achievement.393.name: Slugging Around
achievement.394.description: [EN] It's a wound-up wooden lizard! Well, stranger things have happened, or so you're told. Just hop on and let this wood-and-tin contraption take you anywhere you want to wind down a bit. And hope you don't get hit by lightning underway.
achievement.394.name: Toucher du bois
achievement.395.description: [EN] This must be underwater love - this enormous crustacean now does thy bidding. Or maybe it's just in it for a little more of that shrimp barbecue, as that's a little hard to come by in the sea.
achievement.395.name: Crevettes Frites
achievement.396.description: [EN] What a blast from the past! This thankful patient thinks you missed your dentist vocation. It's now ready to take a bite of the future and to carry you to your next adventure, or your next patient.
achievement.396.name: Hors de l'âge de pierre
achievement.397.description: [EN] A drop of oil and you're good to go. This unique mount will roll merrily in and out of any strange place you want to visit. If you see no exit, you probably ended up in a circus ring. Ah well, the show must go on!
achievement.397.name: Stuntman
achievement.398.description: [EN] Installing that control unit was a no-brainer. Now you're in control to make it walk this way or that, or to change tack at any moment if required. Your faithful walker mount obeys your every command.
achievement.398.name: Équipez-vous
achievement.399.description: [EN] Hunter's greeting! Your skillful use of the slingshot actually stunned a large bear. The creature is slightly dazed, but seems susceptible to your commands. Let's declare open season on all our foes!
achievement.399.name: Bearbaiting
achievement.4.description: [EN] You've always been a rebel - admit it! Supplying prisoners, caring for outcasts, stealing from the rich and giving to the poor - no wait, that was another story.
achievement.4.name: Vive la Résistance
achievement.40.description: [EN] You've hugged bears, pushed mammoths and proved your drinking skills. And even though you have a slight hangover, a partially fractured rib and some greasy hair on your tongue, you're quite proud to call yourself a honorary barbarian from now on.
achievement.40.name: Barbare honoraire
achievement.400.description: [EN] 'Sweets for my steed' could be your motto. An impressive horse is eating out of your hand. Saddle up and be ready to find adventure, new friends, and maybe someone to shoe your horse now and then.
achievement.400.name: Fer à cheval porte-bonheur
achievement.401.description: [EN] By cleverly using a leech to cool that raging bull's blood, you managed not to get swamped or trampled in a water buffalo stampede. The creature is now docile and follows your every command.
achievement.401.name: Bête des marais
achievement.402.description: [EN] Seems like this spider has got a sweet tooth. As a result, eight hairy legs are now at your disposal to crawl and weave at your whim, and strike fear into the hearts of men.
achievement.402.name: Spin off
achievement.403.description: [EN] Here's looking at you, kid. This ancient creature seems to size you up with its brilliant eyes and barely tolerates you riding it. Maybe it thinks you're the defrosted snack, after all?
achievement.403.name: Éblouissement glacial
achievement.404.description: [EN] You succeeded in finding and charting several previously unexplored landmarks and locations for the Adventurer's Guild, you probably never need to ask anyone for the way - do you?
achievement.404.name: Cartography 101
achievement.405.description: [EN] Lifting the secrets of a fabulous palace and defeating a beautiful demon princess was a thrilling experience indeed. This site's marvels nearly matched its terrors. Nearly.
achievement.405.name: Raider du palais perdu
achievement.406.description: C'est dangereux d'y aller seul... Emmenez dix amis.
achievement.406.name: The More the Merrier
achievement.408.description: Tu as vécu l'enfer. Sept fois. Vous avez vaincu les démons. D'innombrables fois. Vous mettez fin aux prétentions d'ascendant de Ferumbras. Une fois pour toutes.
achievement.408.name: Guerrier de la Faille
achievement.41.description: [EN] You're the one who poses the questions around here, and you know how to get the answers you want to hear. Besides, you're a famous exorcist and slay a few vampires and demons here and there. You and your stake are a perfect team.
achievement.41.name: Grand Inquisiteur
achievement.410.description: [EN] You sucessfully fought against all odds to protect your world from an ascending god! – You weren't there for the hat only after all?
achievement.410.name: Chasseur de chapeaux
achievement.411.description: [EN] You didn't manage to become an ogre chief. But at least you are, beyond doubt, a worthy ogre chef.
achievement.411.name: Chef ogre
achievement.412.description: [EN] You opposed man-eating ogres and clumsy clomps. You grappled with hungry chieftains, desperate goblins and angry spirits. So you truly overcame the wild vastness of Krailos.
achievement.412.name: L'appel de la nature
achievement.413.description: [EN] You have entered the heart of destruction and valiantly defeated the world devourer. By your actions you have postponed the end of the world — at least for a while.
achievement.413.name: Fin de la fin
achievement.414.description: [EN] After a long journey and dedication you were favoured by fortune and have tamed all three elusive beasts of the vortex. Unless the Vortexion decides you're a tasty morsel you can enjoy your small stable of ravaging beasts from beyond.
achievement.414.name: Dompteur de vortex
achievement.415.description: [EN] Don't forget, even your rhino sometimes needs a hug. A careful one in this case.
achievement.415.name: Cavalier de rhinocéros
achievement.416.description: [EN] You could not resist the taste of the forbidden fruit. Since you don't feel changed at all, it couldn't have been that bad after all. Or could it?
achievement.416.name: Fruit défendu
achievement.417.description: [EN] Perhaps with so much acquired knowledge, never meant for you, you know even when to stop! Time will tell whether this knowledge will do more harm or good.
achievement.417.name: Connaissance interdite
achievement.418.description: [EN] You wandered the world of Tibia in search of the ancient dragons' hoards. You are sure, you found them all.
achievement.418.name: Chasseur de trésor
achievement.419.description: Vous avez rencontré le légendaire Premier Dragon et avez survécu. C'est certainement une raison de célébrer.
achievement.419.name: Raison de célébrer
achievement.42.description: Weehee ! Frappez ces vers ! Vous savez certainement manier un gros marteau.
achievement.42.name: Chasse-vers
achievement.420.description: [EN] You assisted a very prominent fae and you fought tooth and nail to earn this title.
achievement.420.name: Assistante de la Fée des Dents
achievement.421.description: [EN] Teasing fairies is fun. They leave behind such pretty clouds of glittering dust when chased. Just hope they don't get you back for it.
achievement.421.name: Fée taquine
achievement.422.description: [EN] You have managed to stall the worst incursion of corruption. Still this is just one battle won in an all out war for your world.
achievement.422.name: Corruption contenue
